numerical_claims.claim: Total borrowings decreased from 472.0 million euros to 368.2 million euros over the same timeframe.
numerical_claims.label: INCORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities section) and Note 34 show total borrowings principal of EUR 441,620,580 at 31.12.2024 and EUR 339,578,431 at 31.12.2025.
numerical_claims.error_explanation: The candidate incorrectly states borrowings decreased from 472.0M to 368.2M. Source data shows a decrease from EUR 441.6M to EUR 339.6M.

claim_checks.label: CONTRADICTED
claim_checks.source_evidence: Total liabilities decreased from EUR 471,993,221 (2024) to EUR 368,171,788 (2025) per the Consolidated Statement of Financial Position. However, the specific 'Borrowings' line item decreased from EUR 391,212,247 (2024) to EUR 267,562,839 (2025), not from EUR 472.0 million to EUR 368.2 million as claimed. The claim incorrectly attributes the total liability decrease to 'borrowings'.
claim_checks.reason: The claim misattributes the decrease in total liabilities (EUR 472M to EUR 368M) to 'borrowings', while the SOURCE shows borrowings decreased from EUR 391.2M to EUR 267.6M. The numbers in the claim match total liabilities, not the borrowings line item, creating a direct contradiction.
